en.hubeali:
From him, from Musa Bin Al Hassan, from Ali Bin Suleyman, from one of the middle-men, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>,
that he complained to him<sup>asws</sup> of moisture (acidity), so he<sup>asws</sup> ordered him that he should eat the thyme upon the empty stomach’.
en.sarwar: 2. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from Musa ibn al-Hassan from Ali ibn Sulayman from certain ones of al-Wasit who has said the following:
“I once complained before abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about rutubah (acidity) and he (the Imam) commanded me to eat thyme complete and uncrushed.”
